data.title: /U P D A T E - Interlude Biopharma Co./
data.description:
Interlude Biopharma Launches at the International Celiac Disease Symposium and Announces Prevention-Focused Phase 3 Clinical Trial

Interlude Biopharma Launches at the International Celiac Disease Symposium and Announces Prevention-Focused Phase 3 Clinical Trial

PR Newswire

MIAMI and MELBOURNE, Australia, Nov. 19, 2026

FDA Clears IND for First Celiac Prevention Study Expected to Start in First Quarter of 2027

MIAMI and MELBOURNE, Australia, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mark Paresky, co-founder and executive chairman of Interlude Biopharma Co., today announced the company's public launch at the 21st International Celiac Disease Symposium (ICDS 2026) and introduced plans for a prevention-focused Phase 3 trial to evaluate larazotide acetate as a therapy to protect the gut against gluten-induced injury. Interlude expects to initiate the study in the first quarter of 2027 in the United States.

Larazotide acetate, Interlude's lead drug candidate, is an oral, locally acting peptide designed to regulate intestinal tight junctions—the gatekeepers of the intestinal barrier—by acting as a zonulin inhibitor. Because it operates at an early, upstream step before an immune response is triggered in the intestine, larazotide acetate's mechanism of action extends beyond celiac disease, offering potential therapeutic applications across any chronic inflammatory disease in which zonulin-mediated barrier dysfunction is implicated.

Currently, there are no treatments for celiac disease approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). While a strict gluten-free diet remains the only management option, many people with celiac disease continue to experience persistent symptoms and intestinal damage due to unavoidable gluten exposure.

"When my young daughter was diagnosed with celiac disease, our family saw firsthand how it affected her health and became a daily burden for all of us, from school lunches and birthday parties to restaurant meals and travel. Even with a strict gluten-free diet, accidental exposure is a constant concern," Paresky said. "Upon her becoming a patient of Dr. Alessio Fasano, a pediatric gastroenterologist and celiac disease researcher, we learned about his work on larazotide acetate and the science behind it. We acquired the program and built Interlude to answer one question in a rigorous Phase 3 study: whether this investigational therapy can help prevent symptoms and intestinal injury from gluten exposure."

Historically, clinical trials in celiac disease have been challenged by study designs and primary endpoints that were not well-suited to capture clear efficacy signals. Recognizing larazotide acetate's distinct upstream mechanism, the FDA advised shifting away from traditional interventional trials, which attempt to treat patients in "real-life" settings after the immune system is already activated, in favor of a preventive trial design aimed at stopping the inflammatory cascade before it begins.

The potential of larazotide acetate as an adjunct to a gluten-free diet is supported by extensive clinical data. In a 342-patient, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b trial, a 0.5 mg dose of larazotide acetate met its primary endpoint of reduction in celiac disease symptoms in patients on a gluten-free diet. At the time, it was the largest randomized, controlled trial conducted in celiac disease, with its findings published in Gastroenterology. Click here to read the publication.

Dr. Fasano, the W. Allan Walker Professor of Pediatrics at Harvard Medical School and chief of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Nutrition at Mass General Brigham for Children, said, "In celiac disease, gluten exposure triggers a cascade of events, including functional disruption of the gut barrier, translocation of gluten peptides from the gut lumen into the lamina propria, and the subsequent triggering of an immune response leading to the classic celiac enteropathy in genetically predisposed individuals. Following the FDA's recommendation, Interlude's Phase 3 trial is designed to evaluate whether larazotide acetate can help prevent intestinal damage caused by gluten exposure, rather than simply treating symptoms after they occur. This is the first time that a preventive trial will be performed in celiac disease because of the unique mechanism of action of larazotide, which is amenable to a preventive approach. By assessing both clinical symptoms and preservation of intestinal architecture, the trial aims to demonstrate the potential of this approach to protect patients from the consequences of gluten exposure. Positive results would be very promising for the entire celiac disease community."

The FDA has granted Fast Track designation to larazotide acetate for the treatment of celiac disease. Interlude's Phase 3 study, for which the Investigational New Drug application is in effect and the protocol has been approved, consists of:

  • Design: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter superiority trial at up to 100 U.S. sites.
  • Participants: Approximately 414 adolescents and adults, ages 12 to 80, with biopsy-confirmed, well-controlled celiac disease.
  • Treatment: Larazotide acetate 0.25 mg or 0.5 mg, or placebo, three times daily for 14 weeks.
  • Gluten exposure: Following a run-in period, participants will receive a study bar containing 500 mg of gluten for 12 weeks (every other day for four weeks, followed by daily administration for eight weeks), representing the upper range of estimated real-world inadvertent exposure.
  • Primary endpoint: The proportion of responders who maintain intestinal mucosal architecture and symptom control on the Celiac Disease Symptom Diary.
  • Additional information about the trial and study sites can be found on clinicaltrials.gov (NCT07944625).

"For years we've been part of the celiac community because of our family's experience living with the disease," Paresky added. "As we prepare to begin the Phase 3 study, we are working with clinical sites and speaking with celiac disease patient organizations about how we can collaborate. We are grateful for the chance to try to do more for families living with this disease."

ICDS 2026 takes place Nov. 17-20 at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, in Melbourne, Australia. Held every two years under the International Society for the Study of Celiac Disease, ICDS is the leading global meeting dedicated to celiac disease, bringing together scientists, clinicians, dietitians, and patient organizations. This year's symposium is the first held in the Southern Hemisphere. For more information, visit www.icds2026.org.

About Celiac Disease

Celiac disease is a serious autoimmune disease that occurs in genetically predisposed people in whom the ingestion of gluten leads to damage in the small intestine. It is estimated that one in 100 people worldwide have celiac disease, but only approximately 30 percent are properly diagnosed. Currently, the only treatment for celiac disease is lifelong adherence to a strict gluten-free diet. People living gluten-free must avoid foods containing wheat, rye, and barley. Even the ingestion of a small amount of food containing gluten can trigger symptoms and damage the intestine.

About Interlude Biopharma

Interlude Biopharma Co. is a late-stage, drug-development company focused on celiac disease. Its lead candidate, larazotide acetate, is an investigational, first-in-class oral tight junction regulator designed to protect the intestinal barrier against gluten-induced injury when administered as an adjunct to a gluten-free diet. Larazotide acetate has received Fast Track designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and is advancing into a Phase 3 trial in the United States. The company is headquartered in Miami.

For more information, visit www.interludebio.com. Follow Interlude Biopharma on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

data.title: Litify Recognized on 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for Third Consecutive Year
data.description:
Litify Recognized on 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for Third Consecutive Year

The AI-native, end-to-end legal technology platform earns recognition for the third consecutive year, achieving 139% revenue growth while continuing to invest in AI embedded throughout legal operations

Litify, legal's only AI-native Platform of Action, today announced that it was recognized on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, a ranking of the 500 fastest-growing technology companies in North America, now in its 32nd year. Litify achieved 139% revenue growth from 2022 to 2025, marking its third consecutive year of recognition on the list.

Litify's continued growth reflects its investment in building an end-to-end legal technology platform with AI natively embedded throughout, rather than layered onto individual workflows. By bringing together data, workflows, and intelligent automation in a single platform, Litify is helping law firms and corporate legal departments move beyond fragmented technology solutions and integrate AI directly into their day-to-day operations. Since launching Litify AI in 2024, the company has accelerated its innovation roadmap, expanding its capabilities to help legal professionals move beyond accessing information to take meaningful action.

In 2026, Litify expanded its native AI capabilities across the platform with the introduction of AI Time Capture, Instant Demands, and Call Intelligence, designed to reduce administrative burdens, streamline complex processes, and help legal teams operate more efficiently. The company also advanced its Litify Agentic Expert (ACE), introducing more sophisticated embedded AI agents that can execute multi-step workflows, surface actionable insights, and support legal professionals throughout the lifecycle of a matter.

Together, these advancements reinforce Litify’s position as an AI-native Platform of Action, enabling legal organizations to move beyond isolated AI tools and embed intelligent automation throughout their operations. This integrated approach helps organizations reduce technology fragmentation, accelerate AI adoption, and empower legal professionals to focus on higher-value work, improve client experiences and drive stronger business outcomes.

Today, Litify is trusted by more than 70,000 legal professionals and over 450 enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500. Since its founding in 2016, the company has continued to expand its platform and capabilities to meet the evolving needs of legal organizations, supporting a growing range of practice areas and enterprise workflows.

Litify was also recognized on the 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ lists.

Overall, the 2026 Technology Fast 500 companies achieved revenue growth ranging from 97% to 66,330% over the three-year time frame, with an average growth rate of 1,134%.

About the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500

Now in its 32nd year, the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 provides a ranking of the fastest-growing tech companies — both public and private — in North America. Technology Fast 500 award winners are selected based on percentage fiscal year revenue growth from 2022 to 2025.

In order to be eligible for Technology Fast 500 recognition, companies must own proprietary intellectual property or proprietary technology that significantly contributes to the company’s operating revenues. Companies must have base-year (fiscal year 2022) operating revenues of at least US$50,000, and current-year (fiscal year 2025) operating revenues of at least US$5 million, with a growth rate of 50% or greater. Additionally, companies must be in business for a minimum of four years and be headquartered within North America (United States and Canada).

About Litify

Unleash your team's full potential.

Litify is building the last platform legal teams will ever need, powering a new era for the legal industry through its AI-native Platform of Action. Since its inception in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact. Trusted by over 70K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 — the industry-leading solution combines trusted cloud-based technology, configurable and AI-native workflows, and powerful business analytics. Its capabilities span matter and intake management, document generation, timekeeping and billing, legal hold and corporate eBilling, mobile, and more.

By integrating next-generation AI actions and insights across the platform, Litify offers a future-ready solution that enhances strategic decision-making, increases client satisfaction, and enables every teammate to operate at their full potential.

To learn more and request your personalized demo, visit www.litify.com.

About Deloitte

*Please see www.deloitte.com/us/about for a detailed description of their legal structure.

data.title: Crystal Clean Announces Acquisitions of Insta-Clean and Green Site Services
data.description:
Crystal Clean Announces Acquisitions of Insta-Clean and Green Site Services

Crystal Clean Announces Acquisitions of Insta-Clean and Green Site Services

PR Newswire

HOFFMAN ESTATES, Ill., Nov. 19, 2026

HOFFMAN ESTATES, Ill., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Crystal Clean, Inc. ("Crystal Clean"), a leading provider of specialized environmental and waste management solutions to commercial and industrial end markets and a portfolio company of investment affiliates of J.F. Lehman & Company, LLC ("JFLCO"), today announced that it has closed the acquisitions of Insta-Clean LLC ("Insta-Clean") and Green Site Services Group, Inc. ("GSS").

Insta-Clean, headquartered in Lake Havasu City, AZ, is a manufacturer of industrial parts washing equipment. Insta-Clean's product portfolio spans standard and custom-engineered sinks, spray cabinets, and pass-through and conveyor washers.

GSS, headquartered in Franklin, MA, provides emergency spill response, environmental remediation, hazardous and regulated waste management, industrial services, and compliance support to industrial, commercial, and public sector customers across New England. GSS also operates an industrial wastewater treatment facility in Dover, NH.

Brian Recatto, President & CEO of Crystal Clean, commented, "Vertical integration and strategic geographic expansion remain core elements of our value creation plan, and the acquisitions of Insta-Clean and GSS reflect those priorities. Insta-Clean has long been a trusted partner to our parts cleaning program, and bringing its manufacturing capabilities in-house will allow us to better support our customers. GSS strengthens our presence in the northeastern U.S. and adds a range of capabilities that will support our technical services initiative. We are thrilled to welcome both teams to Crystal Clean and look forward to our partnership."

Dave Thomas, Director of Crystal Clean and Partner at JFLCO, added, "The acquisitions of Insta-Clean and GSS reflect our disciplined strategy in pairing strategic acquisitions with organic investment in the Crystal Clean platform. These additions reinforce Crystal Clean's position as an acquiror of choice as we continue to execute on our growth strategy."

A&O Shearman provided legal counsel to Crystal Clean on each acquisition.

About Crystal Clean:

Crystal Clean provides environmental and industrial services to manufacturers and other industrial businesses, utilities, and governmental entities. Its service programs include parts cleaning, regulated containerized and bulk waste management, used oil collection and re-refining, wastewater vacuum, emergency and spill response, industrial and field services, and waste antifreeze collection, recycling, and product sales. These services help customers manage their used chemicals and liquid and solid wastes, while also helping to minimize their regulatory burdens.

For more information about Crystal Clean, please visit https://www.crystal-clean.com/.

About J.F. Lehman & Company

Founded in 1992, J.F. Lehman & Company focuses exclusively on investing in the aerospace, defense, government, maritime, environmental and infrastructure industries. The firm has over $9 billion in AUM across its private equity and credit strategies and offices in New York and Washington, D.C.
www.jflpartners.com

data.title: Specialized Manufacturers Draw Investor Interest Across the U.S. Metals Industry
data.description:
Specialized Manufacturers Draw Investor Interest Across the U.S. Metals Industry

Specialized Manufacturers Draw Investor Interest Across the U.S. Metals Industry

PR Newswire

CHICAGO, Nov. 19, 2026

BGL Metals & Advanced Metals Manufacturing Insider

CHICAGO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The U.S. Metals industry has entered a favorable period for investment and consolidation, according to an industry report released by the Metals & Advanced Metals Manufacturing investment banking team at Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL). Strong opportunities exist across the fragmented U.S. service center, advanced metals manufacturing, and other metal-related markets to build scaled platforms around specialized capabilities and scarce production capacity.

 BGL examines key forces reshaping the U.S. metals industry and the growing investment and M&A opportunities.

Download and read the BGL Metals & Advanced Metals Manufacturing Insider here: https://bit.ly/BGLMetalsInsiderNovember2026

BGL Managing Director Vince Pappalardo: "Some of the most attractive investment opportunities are in the downstream manufacturers that turn metal into specialized components. These businesses often have capabilities, customer qualifications, and production capacity that are difficult to replicate, making them increasingly important to strategic buyers and private equity investors."

BGL Director Hubert de la Vauvre: "We are seeing improvement directly in the deal environment. There has been an uptick in pitching activity, particularly for healthy manufacturers with strong backlogs and exposure to faster-growing end markets."

Inside the report, BGL examines key forces reshaping the U.S. metals industry and the growing investment and M&A opportunities across the value chain.

Key takeaways:

  • The market forces creating favorable conditions for investment and consolidation across the U.S. metals industry
  • Where the investment opportunity is growing across the metals value chain
  • The notable transactions that signal growing investor participation in selected metals end-markets

BGL expects Metals M&A activity to remain strong into 2027. The combination of domestic investment, growing end-market demand, and continued fragmentation is creating opportunities for both strategic acquirers and private equity firms.

About BGL's Metals & Advanced Metals Manufacturing Investment Banking Team

BGL's Metals & Advanced Metals Manufacturing team has deep sector knowledge and extensive Metals M&A transaction experience within major subsectors of the broader metals industry. Coverage includes mills and foundries, metals recycling, advanced metals manufacturing, and metal service centers.

About Brown Gibbons Lang & Company
Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL) is a leading independent investment bank and financial advisory firm focused on the global middle market. The firm advises private and public corporations and private equity groups on mergers and acquisitions, capital markets, financial restructurings, business valuations and opinions, and other strategic matters. BGL has offices in Boston, Chicago, Cleveland, Los Angeles, and New York. The firm is also a founding member of REACH Cross-Border Mergers & Acquisitions, enabling BGL to service clients in 30 countries around the world. Securities transactions are conducted through Brown, Gibbons, Lang & Company Securities, LLC, an affiliate of Brown Gibbons Lang & Company LLC and a registered broker-dealer and member of FINRA and SIPC. data.title: AM Best Revises Outlooks to Positive for United National Life Insurance Company of America
data.description:
AM Best Revises Outlooks to Positive for United National Life Insurance Company of America

AM Best has revised the outlooks to positive from stable and affirmed the Financial Strength Rating of B++ (Good) and the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating of “bbb+” (Good) of United National Life Insurance Company of America (UNL) (Omaha, NE).

The Credit Ratings (ratings) reflect UNL’s balance sheet strength, which AM Best assesses as very strong, as well as its adequate operating performance, limited business profile and appropriate enterprise risk management (ERM).

The positive outlook reflects the trend of favorable operating performance UNL has exhibited to date. The company has reported consistent premium growth. Additionally, UNL’s operating return-on-revenue (ROR) and return-on-equity (ROE) metrics have been maintained in the high double digit range with the five-year ROR and ROE at 23.1% and 24.7%, respectively.

UNL’s balance sheet strength is very strong, supported by capital growth through retained earnings and modest dividends. UNL’s business profile is limited with its core supplemental health and final expense products geared mostly to the over-65 senior market. UNL has a formal ERM program that is mature with established processes and a good governance structure.

This press release relates to Credit Ratings that have been published on AM Best’s website. For all rating information relating to the release and pertinent disclosures, including details of the office responsible for issuing each of the individual ratings referenced in this release, please see AM Best’s Recent Rating Activity web page. For additional information regarding the use and limitations of Credit Rating opinions, please view Guide to Best's Credit Ratings. For information on the proper use of Best’s Credit Ratings, Best’s Performance Assessments, Best’s Preliminary Credit Assessments and AM Best press releases, please view Guide to Proper Use of Best’s Ratings & Assessments.

data.title: Vail Resorts Turns Up the Volume with ILLENIUM in Vail, John Summit in Whistler and a Full Winter of Music and Mountain Culture
data.description:
Vail Resorts Turns Up the Volume with ILLENIUM in Vail, John Summit in Whistler and a Full Winter of Music and Mountain Culture

Vail Resorts Turns Up the Volume with ILLENIUM in Vail, John Summit in Whistler and a Full Winter of Music and Mountain Culture

PR Newswire

BROOMFIELD, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026
  • ILLENIUM opens Vail Mountain's biggest music season to date on Dec. 11, 2026, and John Summit returns to Whistler Blackcomb on March 20-21, 2027
  • Guests who want a front-row seat to music and culture in the mountains should lock in an Epic Pass; Last chance to buy a Pass is December 6

Images Approved for Media Use Available HERE

BROOMFIELD, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vail Resorts is turning up the volume this winter. GRAMMY-nominated producer ILLENIUM opens Vail Mountain's biggest music season to date on Dec. 11, 2026, and John Summit returns to Whistler Blackcomb on March 20-21, 2027, headlining a season of live music, après and mountain culture across the company's resorts. Additional headline performances will be announced as the season gets underway.

From on-mountain DJ sets to village celebrations, intimate dinners and milestone anniversaries, resorts including Vail Mountain, Breckenridge, Whistler Blackcomb, Park City Mountain, Beaver Creek Resort, Keystone Resort, and Heavenly Mountain Resort will host new events and returning favorites that immerse guests in music and mountain culture. Vail Mountain leads the way with seven on-mountain pop-up performances – three more than last season – plus two new on-mountain music venues. Guests who want a front-row seat to the season should lock in an Epic Pass; last chance to buy a Pass is December 6.

"Music and après culture have always been part of our mountain experience," said Jody Churich, Senior Vice President of Destination Resorts at Vail Resorts. "From ILLENIUM in Vail and John Summit in Whistler to village performances and dance parties, these are experiences people will remember long after the lifts stop spinning. This winter, we're bringing even more of them to resorts across our mountain portfolio."

Music Across the Mountains

Headline Performances: From GRAMMY-nominated headliners in Vail to a house music takeover in Whistler, the season's biggest names bring festival energy to the mountains.

  • At Vail Mountain (CO), GRAMMY-nominated, multi-platinum recording artists ILLENIUM opens the 2026/27 music season Dec. 11 at the newly renovated Dobson Arena in Lionshead. Ian Asher follows Jan. 16, with tickets available at AXS.com. Another headliner will be announced for an April 10 show at Dobson.
  • At Whistler Blackcomb (BC), John Summit's Experts Only returns to Lot 7 March 20–21 after making its Whistler debut last March. More lineup details are coming soon, and tickets are available HERE.
  • At Heavenly (CA/NV), Elderbrook headlines the Season Kickoff party Dec. 19 at Lakeview Lodge, high above Lake Tahoe, setting the tone for a winter of DJ performances.
  • At Park City Mountain (UT), the energy of Shaun White's The Snow League spills over from the superpipe to Eagle Plaza in Mountain Village where LP Giobbi performs Jan. 22 and Dombresky brings Disco Dom on Jan. 23. Both shows are free and open to the public.

Après and Live Music: From DJ sets at the base of Vail Mountain's Gondola One to mountaintop music sessions on Whistler Mountain, guests will find new and returning ways to keep the energy going on mountain and after the lifts stop spinning.

  • At Vail Mountain (CO), this is the biggest music season yet, with seven on-mountain performances (three more than last winter) and two new music venues. Vail Après Club™ builds on a 2025/26 season that brought globally recognized artists including Sofi Tukker, Dillon Francis, Chris Lorenzo and John Summit to the mountain. This season, new artists, venues and mountain activations will be announced on social media @VailMtn. Every Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 2:30 to 5:30 p.m., Après All Day at Vail Express Lift Bar brings more than 50 performing artists to the stage, nearly double than last season, in collaboration with Vail Mountain partner Outer Range Brewing Co. Next to the Legendary Back Bowls Gate, the reimagined Vail Ice Bar blends alpine nostalgia with a lively outdoor gathering space for drinks, music and après in the heart of the mountain.
  • At Breckenridge (CO), the Kingdom of Breck™ comes to life with high-energy live music across the mountain and in town. The excitement begins during the Rockstar Energy Open with free performances by RL Grime and PHRVA at Blue River Plaza. Throughout the season, and perched high on Peak 9, The Overlook becomes an après destination for the Après at the Overlook Music Series, with live DJ sets and drink specials set against 11,000-foot views. Nearby, Keystone (CO) brings back Keystone After Dark, inviting guests to keep après going into the evening near the largest mountaintop snow structure in North America on six select dates.
  • At Whistler Blackcomb (BC), the village après scene is as much a part of the trip as the alpine. Whistler favorites including the Hairfarmers and Taylor James will play at Merlin's, GLC and Dusty's all season long. Up top, the popular Corona DJ Sessions return to the Corona Mountain Top Lodge on Whistler Mountain starting Jan. 17, with more details coming soon.
  • At Park City Mountain (UT), Canyons Village is the place to be when the lifts stop spinning. Après at the Airstream DJ sets keep the energy going at the Umbrella Bar every Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 2 to 5 p.m. starting Nov. 27. Canyons Village Silver Sky Nights pair live music with fireworks over the village on Dec. 18, Jan. 16, Feb. 6 and Feb. 13.
  • At Heavenly (CA/NV), après comes with a view of Lake Tahoe. The Views and Vibes series brings popular DJs including Elderbrook, Bob Moses, Vandelux and Snakehips to the stage high above the lake all season long.
  • At Mount Snow (VT), the après traditions run deep and the parties run late. Snow Barn, a rite of passage for any Mount Snow visit, brings live music, DJs and late-night entertainment starting Dec. 19, with acts including One More Time, Lazer Dad and Haus of Monsters. Local favorite Bruce Jacques returns to Cuzzins for another season of sing-along performances, and reservations go fast. On Jan. 30, the Carinthia Lodge House Party fills all three floors of the lodge with music, drinks and games. In spring, Reggaefest brings live reggae from IRIEspect to the main stage March 20–22.

"There's an energy in a mountain town when the music starts, and at many of our resorts you'll hear it from the slopes all the way into town," said Churich. "It might be a band on a sunny mountaintop deck or a headliner on a village stage after the lifts stop. Whether guests are front row for the big show or dancing in ski boots with friends after a day on the snow, we want every one of them to leave with a story and an unforgettable moment."

Epic Pass Holders Get More Out of Every Event; Last chance to buy a Pass is December 6
Last chance to buy an Epic Pass is Dec. 6, so guests eager to get on the mountain this winter still have time to lock in access and savings. With new savings for young adults, guests ages 13–30 save 20% on an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass. Plus, all guests who purchase an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass now will receive five Epic Friend Tickets offering 50% off adult lift tickets, making it easier to bring the crew along and save. Epic Pass Holders can also save on the rest of their trip with exclusive savings through Epic Mountain Rewards, including 20% off food, lodging, lessons, rentals, and more.

About Vail Resorts, Inc.
Vail Resorts operates a network of 42 iconic mountain resorts across North America, Europe, and Australia. Our portfolio includes premier destinations such as Vail Mountain, Beaver Creek, Breckenridge, Park City Mountain, Whistler Blackcomb, and Keystone; beloved regional mountains like Stowe, Heavenly, and Northstar; and local resorts close to metro areas that help to introduce the next generation of skiers and riders to the sport. Together, these resorts provide guests with an unmatched range of mountain experiences connected through the Epic Pass. We are passionate about providing an Experience of a Lifetime to our team members and guests. Through our environmental and social responsibility work, we are committed to reaching a zero net operating footprint by 2030, supporting our employees and communities, and broadening engagement in our sport. Beyond our resorts, Vail Resorts operates industry-leading ski and ride school programs, rental operations, distinctive dining and hospitality experiences, retail operations, and the Grand Teton Lodge Company. Learn more about our company at www.VailResorts.com, or discover our resorts and Pass options at www.EpicPass.com.

data.title: Mile High Labs Files Type II Drug Master File with FDA for CBD Isolate
data.description:
Mile High Labs Files Type II Drug Master File with FDA for CBD Isolate

Mile High Labs Files Type II Drug Master File with FDA for CBD Isolate

PR Newswire

LOVELAND, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026

Mile High Labs continues to build its pharmaceutical-channel capabilities with a Type II DMF for CBD Isolate

LOVELAND, Colo., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mile High Labs, a global leader in hemp-derived cannabinoid ingredients, today announced that it has filed a Type II Drug Master File (DMF #044151) with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its CBD Isolate, a 98% cannabidiol isolate. The file was submitted on October 2, 2026.

Companies developing drug products can reference DMF #044151 in their own FDA submissions through a Letter of Authorization from Mile High Labs.

"This filing reflects how we have always run this business," said John Davis, Chief Operating Officer of Mile High Labs. "As our industry has matured over the past decade, investing in quality has remained our true north at Mile High Labs, enabling us to bring our cannabinoid ingredients into highly regulated markets around the world. Our Type II Drug Master File for CBD Isolate represents an important milestone in our ongoing advancement within the pharmaceutical channel, building on a unified quality system that already supplies consumer and regulated medicinal products. As we continue to expand our pharmaceutical capabilities and regulatory readiness, we're excited to be preparing for an FDA inspection and strengthening our ability to serve drug developers in the U.S. and abroad."

The file is expected to appear on FDA's public list of Drug Master Files in its next quarterly update.

About Mile High Labs

For over 10 years, Mile High Labs has been committed to high-quality hemp-derived cannabinoid ingredients, supplying brands and formulators in the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, Japan and other regulated markets. Based in Loveland, Colorado, the company's portfolio includes CBD, CBG, CBN and CBC isolates, distillates and water-soluble formats.
